svg.title: Recovery / pinned sources and publication
svg.desc: Only PostgreSQL-declared foreign keys are shown. Recovery plans reference incident and approval records; executions reference plans; publication rows reference the dataset/partition revision; legacy approval projection rows reference approval requests. Snapshots and recovery outbox events have no declared FK.
svg.text: Versioned source facts, approved recovery state, and guarded partition publication.
Other FKs: recovery_plans -> incident_controls + approval_requests; legacy import/projection -> approval_requests.
Those referenced tables are omitted from this 8-entity view. Publication FK is the tuple (dataset, partition_dt).
Source hashes bind content; they do not prove freshness or business validity.
PK/FK: PostgreSQL constraints only. Solid gray FK: child N -> parent 1; ON DELETE / UPDATE NO ACTION.
Dashed gray: logical only. Solid blue: dbt derivation. Selected columns; full types and all omitted fields in data-model.md.
